title: Sid Nathan of King and "All She Wanna Do Is Rock"
summary: Glover went to King as arranger and producer, and McRae wrote the hit "All She Wanna Do Is Rock" for Wynonie Harris.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
